title: Transit Report
description: Grouped controls for full loading screens. Short transitions show the indicator only.

Appearance.label: Theme
Appearance.hint: Choose the faction used by artwork controls set to Theme. Other artwork choices remain independent.

Appearance.label: Character badge
Appearance.hint: Theme uses the selected faction artwork (or Orbiting Star/Orbital Chart with Individual selections). All other choices apply independently. Choose a built-in design or Custom. Custom randomly selects a PNG/JPG/JPEG/GIF from Documents/My Games/Starfield/Transit Report/Artwork/Badges each load. Any filenames; up to 64 images. Restart after changes.

Appearance.label: Loading indicator
Appearance.hint: Theme uses the selected faction artwork (or Orbiting Star/Orbital Chart with Individual selections). All other choices apply independently. Choose a built-in design or Custom. Custom randomly selects a PNG/JPG/JPEG/GIF from Documents/My Games/Starfield/Transit Report/Artwork/Indicators each load. Any filenames; up to 64 images. Restart after changes.

Appearance.label: Loading background
Appearance.hint: Theme uses the selected faction artwork (or Orbiting Star/Orbital Chart with Individual selections). All other choices apply independently. Choose a built-in design or Custom. Custom randomly selects a PNG/JPG/JPEG/GIF from Documents/My Games/Starfield/Transit Report/Artwork/Backgrounds each load. Any filenames; up to 64 images. Restart after changes.

Full loading screen.label: Loading tips
Full loading screen.hint: Show loading tips on loading screens.

Full loading screen.label: Local PC time
Full loading screen.hint: Your computer clock in its local time zone. Updates during loading.

Stat pages.label: Number of stat pages
Stat pages.hint: Maximum 1–5 pages per full load, with four larger lifetime readings per page. Default: two pages.

Lifetime stats.label: Lifetime display
Lifetime stats.hint: Chosen categories, or random lifetime counters from enabled categories. Up to the selected page count.

Lifetime stats.label: General
Lifetime stats.hint: Hours Slept, Hours Waiting, Days Passed, Credits Found, Most Credits Carried, Chests Looted, Food Eaten, Chems Taken, Data Slates Read, Magazines Found, Speech Successes, Powers Learned

Lifetime stats.label: Combat
Lifetime stats.hint: People Killed, Creatures Killed, Robots Killed, Turrets Killed, Critical Strikes, Legendary Enemies Killed, Jet Packs Exploded, Sneak Attacks, Powers Used, Zero G Kills

Lifetime stats.label: Exploration
Lifetime stats.hint: Locations Discovered, Locations Explored, Systems Visited, Planets Scanned, Planets Fully Surveyed, Planets Landed On, Flora Fully Scanned, Fauna Fully Scanned, Unique Creatures Scanned, Temples Found

Lifetime stats.label: Crafting & outposts
Lifetime stats.hint: Food Cooked, Drugs Crafted, Items Scrapped, Items Manufactured, Objects Built, Outposts Built, Cargo Links Established, Workshops Unlocked

Lifetime stats.label: Quests
Lifetime stats.hint: Quests Completed, Activities Completed, Main Quests Completed, Side Quests Completed, Freestar Collective Quests Completed, Crimson Fleet Quests Completed, United Colonies Quests Completed, Ryujin Industries Quests Completed

Lifetime stats.label: Ships
Lifetime stats.hint: Grav Jumps, Ships Sold, Ships Painted, Ship Modules Built, Ships Docked With, Stations Docked With, Ships Customized, Ship Builder Credits Spent, Largest Crew Size, Max Ships Owned

Lifetime stats.label: Crime
Lifetime stats.hint: Times Arrested, Trespasses, Times Caught With Contraband, Total Lifetime Bounty, Largest Bounty, Acts of Piracy, Pockets Picked, Locks Picked, Items Stolen
